verdict.rationale: Docs scatter some relevant signals — platform must integrate Mangopay's hosted KYC/KYB (docs-34), fraud-rule customization is platform-defined (docs-7), and disputes/chargebacks can be contested by the platform before being charged back (docs-12, docs-13) — implying some allocation of responsibility, but there is no single explicit document laying out who owns KYC/AML, card-network compliance, fraud losses, and seller misconduct liability. Missing for 10: a dedicated liability/responsibility-matrix page, explicit statement on card-network compliance ownership, and explicit fraud-loss/seller-misconduct liability allocation.
